label: SMOKE fixture — Reuters fact check (misleading element)
summary: Reuters reported that the U.S. leads in crude-oil production and in total oil and natural-gas supply, but Venezuela, Saudi Arabia and Iran have the largest proven crude reserves, while Russia, Iran and Qatar have the largest proven natural-gas reserves.
title: Fact Check: Donald Trump's inaugural speech examined
nuance: Misleading or context-lacking element of the claim.
